quotes.text: It's God's blessing, and we're trying to take advantage of being able to do what we do and love what we do, and we know what we're doing by now.

It's very important to work with the new generation. That's what keeps you up with the music and what's going on and what they're feeling, and you're writing about feelings, people, and actual things that are happening. It keeps us young and in the business and know where we are going with the business. We're here to show them the room. Follow the yellow brick road or The Isley Brothers road.

I called Tina Knowles and said, 'Hey, you think Beyoncé would do this song with us?' She called back in five minutes, and she said 'Yes.' She don't do a song with just nobody. She was remembering when we did BET one time, and I predicted that [her and her husband] would be the next group — and when I say next group, [I meant] her and Jay-Z would make history. And that's what they did.

I think Puffy was sleepy when he woke up and said that. That's crazy. Music is music, man, and it will always be here… That type of statement doesn't mean anything. That's like me saying rap is dead. It's always going to be there.

A lot of artists, especially when you start out, it's doing that first record, and that's the breakthrough — but the trick is, what are you going to do the second time or the third time and so on? Some people run out of gas. But fortunately for us, we've been able to go the next rounds.

We have to give credit to our family. Our mother and father taught us in the beginning to sing everything. Gospel, country, rhythm and blues, pop, sing, everything that the people want to hear, and that's how you last this long. We're the Kings of Love Songs. We don't want to brag, but you can check us out.
